instructions: Rinse the mackerel and pat them dry. If the fish isn't gutted, ask the fishmonger to do it.
Rub 1 1/2 tsp of the salt over the fish, inside and out. Let them rest for 10 to 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, slice the onions into rings and toss them with the remaining 1/2 tsp salt and 1 tbsp of the olive oil. Cut the lemons into wedges.
Heat a grill pan or grill over medium heat. Grill the onion rings for 4 minutes on each side, until golden at the edges. Transfer them to a plate.

Brush the fish with the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil. Grill for 5 to 6 minutes on one side, then flip and grill the other side for 5 to 6 minutes. The skin should be golden and the flesh should flake when you press the thickest part near the bone.
Transfer the fish to a platter and squeeze over a lemon wedge.
Taste it. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt, or a squeeze of the lemon.
Serve with the grilled onions and the remaining lemon wedges.
method_notes: No version with a rating could be found. Turkish Food and Recipes (no rating) leads, and Taste Table (no rating) is the same recipe: salt the fish, rest it 10 to 15 minutes, grill with onion rings over medium heat, serve with lemon. A little olive oil is added so the fish doesn't stick. The sources' carrot garnish is left out because it wouldn't cook through in this time.
